parameters.content:
## Workflow 4 — Quality Verification

Runs daily at 06:00 to verify ChromaDB has sufficient content for all 6 exams.

**Thresholds:**
- < 50 chunks = alert (may produce poor-quality questions)
- 0 chunks = EMPTY alert (will use hardcoded fallback)

**On alert:**
1. Logs warning to n8n console
2. POSTs to FastAPI /admin/content-alert (saved to data/alerts.json)
3. Automatically triggers re-indexing from data/scraped/

**Backend must be running at:** http://localhost:8003
(run: `cd backend && uvicorn app.main:app --port 8003 --reload`)
